d: FC Barcelona defeated Aston Villa F.C. 3-0 at the Spotify Camp Nou in Matchday 4 of the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League league phase. The clinical home performance effectively ended Aston Villa’s perfect start to their European campaign. The match featured a historic opening milestone in the 7th minute when Villa gifted Barcelona an early advantage. Goalkeeper Zion Suzuki played a risky pass to a pressed João Gomes, whose blind pass across his own box was intercepted by Lamine Yamal.
